title: Quantile characterization of univariate unimodality
summary: Unimodal univariate distributions can be characterized as piecewise convex-concave cumulative distribution functions. In this note we transfer this shape constraint characterization to the quantile function. We show that this characterization comes with the upside that the quantile function of a unimodal distribution is always absolutely continuous and consequently unimodality is equivalent to the quasi-convexity of its Radon-Nikodym derivative, i.e., the quantile density.
